feats.title: Improved Spellwarden Shielding
feats.description: While you are wearing cloth armor, leather armor, or no armor, the bonus to AC from your Swordmage Warding increases by 1.

feats.title: Ensnarement
feats.description: When you use aegis of ensnarement to teleport an enemy, that enemy is also slowed until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Retributive Shield
feats.description: When you use your aegis of shielding power, you gain a +2 bonus to the next attack roll made before the end of your next turn against the foe that triggered the aegis of shielding immediate interrupt.

feats.title: Escalating Assault
feats.description: Each time you make a melee basic attack granted by your aegis of assault power, you gain a cumulative +1 bonus on future attack rolls made for the melee basic attacks granted by this power (up to a maximum bonus of +3). This bonus resets to 0 at the end of the encounter or if you are rendered unconscious.

feats.title: Aegis Accuracy
feats.description: If a target marked by your Swordmage Aegis makes an attack and doesn't include you as a target, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls against the marked creature until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Aegis Vitality
feats.description: Whenever a creature marked by your Swordmage Aegis makes an attack that does not include you as a target, you gain 3 temporary hit points. Increase the temporary hit points to 5 at 11th level, and to 8 at 21st level.

feats.title: Combat Casting
feats.description: When you use a melee swordmage attack power and hit an enemy, your ranged and area swordmage attack powers don't provoke opportunity attacks until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Extended Teleportation
feats.description: Whenever you teleport with a swordmage or swordmage paragon path power, add 1 to the distance you can teleport.

feats.title: Improved Swordbond
feats.description: You can call your bonded weapon to your hand from up to 20 squares away with a minor action.
